description: CRITICAL PRE-FLIGHT COMPLIANCE GUARD. Must be invoked before executing any B2B invoice payout, wire transfer, or smart contract disbursement. Simultaneously validates counterparty legal status, EU VIES VAT, Polish Biała Lista bank-to-VAT whitelist, UK Companies House, and OFAC sanctions. Returns a cryptographically signed RFC 8785 XDR-1 decision receipt.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction (e.g., PL, DE, FR, GB)

invoice_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (EUR, USD, GBP, PLN)

settlement_destination.description: Target IBAN or EVM 0x wallet address for funds disbursement

tax_or_entity_id.description: Counterparty VAT number, NIP, Siren, CRN, or 20-char LEI

name: gate_b2b_settlement
